   - **Title**: Follow-up meeting

   - **Start Time**: 16:00 (since you have a conflict at 10:00)
   - **End Time**: 17:00
   - **Location**: Office 44A
4. **Add participants**: Include your email (emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com).

### To Send Emails:
You can copy the content of the received and sent emails and send them to mark.black-2134@gmail.com manually.

If you need further assistance or have any other requests, feel free to ask!
